export const SEEDED_BUGS: readonly SeededBug[] = [
  {
    name: "empty-title",
    symptom: "An empty or blank title is not refused at the edge; the database check constraint rejects the row and the API answers 500 instead of 400.",
    file: "src/server/app.ts",
    trigger: "POST /api/todos with { title: \"\" }",
  },
  ...

The incident is the check constraint todos_title_not_blank firing on POST /api/todos with an empty title. flags.ts points at app.ts: with empty-title on, newTodoSchema uses looseTitle (z.string().max(200)) instead of strictTitle, so a blank title reaches store.insert and the database refuses it, which the error handler turns into a 500. The existing test for the 400 runs with no flags, so it never saw this path. The reproduction builds the app with bugs: new Set(["empty-title"]) and asserts the 400 with the title named in the issues, for the exact body the tracker recorded and for a title of spaces.

messages.text: The cause is the lenient schema behind the flag, not the constraint and not the error handler. The fix removes the looseTitle path so the strict schema is the only one: newTodoSchema becomes a constant, the title is always strictTitle, and the route calls newTodoSchema.parse. The flag's entry in flags.ts gets fixedBy: "inc-f42f2815" so SAMPLE_BUGS=empty-title is still accepted and now changes nothing. The symptom test in api.test.ts is written to step aside once the entry is marked fixed, so no test is touched.
